title: Central Texas Pest Calendar: A Month-by-Month Checklist
description: A month-by-month pest prevention checklist for Buda, Kyle and Central Texas, covering entry points, standing water, indoor pests and lawn inspections.
summary: Twelve practical check-ins for your home and yard, with links to current Excel Pest services. Local weather can shift pest activity throughout the year.
quick_answer: Check your home throughout the year: entry points and storage in cooler months, outdoor water and ant activity as conditions warm, and lawn damage and hiding places in summer. Weather matters more than exact dates.
body_html: The month-by-month checklist is maintained in tools/growth.py and rendered by the site builder.

faqs.q: Is there a pest-free season in Central Texas?
faqs.a: Indoor pests and sheltered rodent activity can persist in any season. Use sightings and the condition of your property, along with weather, to decide when to request an inspection.

faqs.q: Does the calendar tell me when to apply pesticides?
faqs.a: No. It is a maintenance checklist. Product choice, timing and application depend on the pest, property and label directions; ask the technician what fits your situation.
